about.title: About Legal Compass
about.intro: Plain-language guides to everyday law: contracts, property and tenancy, family and wills, business, and your rights. General information, not legal advice.

sections.heading: Why we exist
sections.body: Law affects everyday life, yet most of it is written for lawyers. Legal Compass explains the basics in plain language so you can understand your position and ask better questions.

sections.heading: What we cover
sections.body:
- **Contracts & Agreements** — how they work and what to check.
- **Property & Tenancy** — renting, buying and owning.
- **Family & Wills** — wills, inheritance and key documents.
- **Business & Companies** — structures, employees and intellectual property.
- **Rights & Procedure** — consumer rights and how courts work.

sections.heading: Important
sections.body: Everything here is general information, not legal advice. Laws differ by country and region and change over time. For advice about your situation, please consult a qualified lawyer.
